text.title: RFC Template for Product Dev Team — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the product-dev RFC: named `inputs[]` entries for `problem` (metric, current, target, date, no solution), `options` (at least two, one chosen, rejection reasons), `blast_radius` (enumerated items with counts, owners and four flags), `rollback` (mechanism, minutes, executor, staging run, points of no return), `milestones` (two or more dated increments inside 6 weeks, last is ship), `status`, `decided_on`, `reviewers` (with commented flag), `comment_deadline`; a one-sentence decision naming the chosen option; supersession links; a review no later than one cycle after ship that re-measures the metric. Validator in scripts/validate-rfc-template-product-dev-team.py enforces it, including the 6-week span, 3-working-day deadline and reviewer coverage of the blast radius.

required.field: the tech lead accountable for the RFC through its outcome review, `role:handle`

named entries: `problem` (`metric`, `current_value`, `target_value`, `by_date`, `statement` with no solution), `options` (at least two, exactly one `chosen`, `rejection_reason` on the rest), `blast_radius` (`items[]` with `kind`, `name`, `owner`, `count`; `schema_change`, `public_api_change`, `data_backfill`, `third_party_change`), `rollback` (`mechanism`, `execute_minutes`, `executor`, `staging_run`, `points_of_no_return[]`), `milestones` (two or more dated increments, last `ship: true`), `status`, `decided_on`, `reviewers` (`handle`, `commented`), `comment_deadline` (r-problem-states-metric-and-target, r-two-options-with-rejection-reasons, r-blast-radius-enumerated, r-rollback-named-timed-and-tested, r-scope-fits-one-cycle-with-milestones, r-decision-has-status-and-supersession, r-reviewers-named-with-comment-deadline)
one declarative sentence naming the chosen option (r-decision-has-status-and-supersession)
`superseded_by` and `supersedes` URLs or null; both directions linked in `evidence[]` (r-decision-has-status-and-supersession)
at least one URL: the metric dashboard or query, the staging rollback run, successor and predecessor RFCs (r-outcome-review-remeasures-problem-metric)

`next_review_at` no later than 6 weeks after the ship milestone; `outcome` null or `remeasured_value`, `same_method`, `result` (met | partially-met | not-met), `url` (r-outcome-review-remeasures-problem-metric)

forbidden.pattern: `problem.statement` naming a technology or migration ("move to GraphQL", "adopt Kafka"), or `problem` with no `current_value`, `target_value` or `by_date` — fm-solution-shaped-problem
`options` with fewer than two entries, every non-chosen option being "do nothing", or a non-chosen option without `rejection_reason` — fm-single-option
`blast_radius.items` empty, a user-segment or API item without `count`, or a blast-radius owner other than the author absent from `reviewers` — fm-blast-radius-low
`rollback` without `mechanism`, `execute_minutes`, `executor` or `staging_run`; `data_backfill: true` or `schema_change: true` with empty `points_of_no_return` — fm-rollback-is-a-sentence
milestone span above 42 days, fewer than two milestones, or a milestone named as a phase ("design", "implementation", "testing") — fm-four-month-rfc

`reviewers` empty or a team / channel handle; `comment_deadline` fewer than 3 working days after `shared_on`; `status: accepted` before every reviewer commented or the deadline passed — fm-approval-by-silence
`status: superseded` with `supersession.superseded_by` null, or the successor missing from `evidence[]` — r-decision-has-status-and-supersession
`review.next_review_at` later than ship plus 42 days, or `review.outcome` recording delivery ("shipped on time") instead of the re-measured metric — r-outcome-review-remeasures-problem-metric

list.item: `problem` carries metric, current value, target value and date, and names no solution (r-problem-states-metric-and-target).
`options` has at least two entries, exactly one chosen, a real alternative besides do-nothing, and a rejection reason on every other (r-two-options-with-rejection-reasons).
`blast_radius.items` lists every service, store, API, job and segment with counts, owners and the four flags (r-blast-radius-enumerated).
`rollback` names mechanism, minutes, executor, staging run, and a point of no return for every irreversible step (r-rollback-named-timed-and-tested).
`milestones` has two or more dated increments within 42 days and the last is the ship date (r-scope-fits-one-cycle-with-milestones).
`decision` is one sentence naming the chosen option; `status` and `decided_on` set; supersession linked both ways (r-decision-has-status-and-supersession).

`reviewers` are people, include every blast-radius owner, and `comment_deadline` is at least 3 working days after `shared_on`; `accepted` only after comments or deadline (r-reviewers-named-with-comment-deadline).
`review.next_review_at` is within 6 weeks of ship and `outcome` re-measures the metric with the same method (r-outcome-review-remeasures-problem-metric).
